posts.title: Bali Padyami Story for Children: King Bali, Vamana and the Promise of Three Steps
posts.description: The story of King Bali and Vamana told for children, why Bali Padyami is celebrated after Deepavali in Karnataka and Maharashtra, its link with Onam, and a simple promise activity for families.

posts.title: Why Do We Light Diyas on Deepavali? Rama's Return to Ayodhya, Told for Children
posts.description: The story of Rama's return to Ayodhya, why Deepavali means a row of lamps, the five days of the festival, and a simple diya activity for children and parents.

posts.title: Run From Fear and It Chases You: Swami Vivekananda, the Monkeys and Bhagavad Gita 2.3
posts.description: The story of Swami Vivekananda and the monkeys of Banaras, what Bhagavad Gita 2.3 says about fear, and one small step children and parents can take today.
